Windows x64 portable release. Adds optional command suggestions and argument hints, selection wrapping in commands, editor font and preview zoom shortcuts, a preview margin typing marker and recovery of the last successful root source while keeping the displaced draft as a separate saved tab. Configure these from Edit > Editor and lecture settings, with direct actions in Edit, View and Build. Suggestions and the marker start off. Recovery captures successful source from this version onward and writes one current checkpoint after an idle interval; it does not create per-keystroke backup history. The executable is unsigned.
